made_for: issue 1752 Gate 2 clean-slate sci-fi calibration pack (Ryan, Nov 22 2026; supersedes Gate 1 pilot1585). Fable, Artoo and Astra (issue 1754) review fixes applied
note: One clip per shot for every weapon family in godot/rules/data/tables.json (FAC_WNAMES checked), impacts for metal, glass, bio and obsidian targets plus energy hits and an ordinary shield block, shield collapses, R416 breach and capability-loss cues behind VS_WOUNDS_V2 (#1741), faction death beats plus the base break, mechanical acoustic UI cues, bridge ambience, and 3 music prototypes (showcase arc, stem-ready loop, reward theme). Space and sci-fi only, close and dry with a firm clean attack and no harsh words, no wind-up or impact inside a fire clip, no domestic foley words. Each item's today field names the baseline cue for the listening page. Stems stay off in Gate 2.

items.cue: battle music prototype, SHOWCASE ARC for Ryan's ear (palette, motif, weight); not the stem source
items.prompt: Dark orchestral space fleet battle score, instrumental, 96 BPM, 4/4, D minor, 36 bars. Weathered low brass, solemn cellos and double basses, deep measured war drums, subtle struck forge-metal resonances. A grave four-note motif on low brass and bowed cello, the notes D, A, F, E, three long notes then a falling last note, returning and developing throughout. Three 12-bar sections: bars 1 to 12 tense and restrained, low cellos and a quiet drum pulse; bars 13 to 24 a driving tactical build with layered brass chords and firmer drums; bars 25 to 36 a solemn, powerful brass and string climax, the last two bars easing back to the opening texture so the piece can repeat. Clear harmonic movement, real emotional weight, restrained and tactical, no vocals, no choir.

items.cue: reward screen music prototype (dying-sun salvage cadence)
items.prompt: Quietly triumphant instrumental reward-screen theme for a dark space strategy game, 80 BPM, 4/4, D Dorian, 16 bars. Warm brass and strings, calm and dignified, not cheesy. A solo cello states a warm four-note motif, the notes D, A, F, E; muted French horns and full low strings answer and swell to hard-won relief, then settle on a held open fifth that can lead back to the start. Real acoustic orchestra, mature and restrained, no vocals, no choir.

items.cue: battle music prototype, STEM-READY LOOP (source for the first stem-separation test)
items.prompt: Dark orchestral space fleet battle score built as one continuous loop, instrumental, 96 BPM, 4/4, D minor, 16 bars. Four parts that all play in every bar from the first to the last: deep measured war drums; cellos and double basses on a driving low ostinato; low brass carrying a grave four-note motif, the notes D, A, F, E, varied every four bars; a sustained pad of strings and forge-metal resonance. Even energy and density from start to finish; the interest comes from a chord progression that moves every two bars and from the motif's variations. Starts at full texture and the final bar leads straight back into the first. No vocals, no choir.
